title: Tourists on the seawall
logline: August. Three tourists on the seawall looking at a phone, the strip on it — a Sunday from 2013, the heron. Behind them, unseen by them, the real estuary with the real heron. From behind, at the page's edge: Wood, walking the pup past.

panels.composition: The seawall in August: three tourists in fleece bent over one phone showing a small watercolor of an estuary with a heron; behind them, over the wall, the estuary itself at low tide with a heron in it, which they are not looking at. Along the page's right edge, from behind, small: a graying man in plaid and a three-legged dog, walking past without stopping.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall in August with three tourists in fleece bent over a phone showing a small watercolor comic page of an estuary and heron, while behind them over the wall the real estuary at low tide with a real heron goes unnoticed, and at the right edge a graying man in plaid flannel and a small three-legged dog walk past seen from behind, no words

notes: The heron on the phone; the heron behind them.
